transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I... well, I'm here because of work. I teach at a secondary school. Lately, I've just been having this feeling about the staff emails. And the morning announcements. It just... feels like they're coded messages. About me. Even when the other teachers try to tell me they're just regular emails sent to the whole staff. I just can't shake it.
About how long have you been having this feeling about the emails and announcements?

I suppose... maybe around four months. That's when I started worrying about the messages. And... well, the other thing. The voice I... sometimes answer. It's all been going on for about four months, I think.
Over these past four months, how has your mood been, particularly regarding feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?
I... no, not really. I mean, I haven't really noticed feeling down or anything like that. Just... normal, I suppose. I still do my usual things. It's just the other stuff that's been bothering me.
Have you been diagnosed with any physical illnesses or medical conditions?
No. I... I haven't been diagnosed with anything like that. Physically, I'm fine.
Have you been using any recreational drugs, alcohol, or medications around the time these experiences started?
No. I... I don't use drugs or anything like that. And I don't really drink. So... no.
